requestedLayout: 4 columns by 4 rows; base directional, walk, battle, punch, casting and knockout poses
review: Sixteen complete separated figures in the requested pose order. Consistent baked-cookie silhouette, blue icing brows and purple gumdrops. Native 32x32 pixel-grid and twelve-color constraints were not literally obeyed: this is a richer raster source requiring central importer reduction, palette quantization and native-size review. Not yet claimed cartridge-ready.
